2026_026_8_a_bmb_2_of_3_bp_7_boulan_midd.paragraph: Barton Malow Builders' award recommendation letter of 3/26/2026 to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, covers Bid Package #7 for the Boulan Middle School renovation and comes to the April 21, 2026 Board agenda as item 8.A, packaged with the complete bid tabulation and a companion letter objecting to the low roofing bidder. The recommended trade awards carry a TOTAL CONTRACTOR COST of $6,630,046, a CONTINGENCY (10%) of $663,004, and a TOTAL CONSTRUCTION COST of $7,293,050. Barton Malow declines to recommend KJP Roofing and Sheet Metal, Inc., the low roofing bidder, citing workmanship at Waterford Schools and Fraiser Schools, and instead recommends JD Candler Roofing Company, Inc. at $2,157,000.

**Source and parties**
Letter dated 3/26/2026 from Josh Eisenman, Project Manager, Barton Malow Builders, 26500 American Dr., Southfield, MI 48034, to Dan Trudel, Assistant Superintendent of Business Services, Troy School District, 4420 Livernois Rd, Troy, MI 48098, on BP#7 Boulan Middle School Renovation. Proposals were received and read publicly on February 19, 2026 and reviewed with Project Architect/Engineer TMP Architecture Inc. The attached tabulation carries Issue Date 2/12/2026 and BID OPENING: DATE: 2/12/2026.

**Recommended awards**

| Bid category | Contractor | Base bid | Alternate #1 | Total recommended |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Roofing | JD Candler Roofing Company, Inc | $2,157,000 | | $2,157,000 |
| Metal Panels | Schena Roofing & Sheet Metal Co., Inc. | $789,000 | $60,207 | $849,207 |
| Glass & Glazing | Daniels Glass Co. Inc | $790,518 | $41,895 | $832,413 |
| Flooring | DF Floor Covering | $702,869 | | $702,869 |
| Hard Tile | Premier Tile Design Inc. | $205,000 | | $205,000 |
| Acoustic Wall Panels | Mid Thumb Contracting Group LLC | $272,352 | | $272,352 |
| Painting | Twin Brothers Painting | $143,000 | | $143,000 |
| General Trades | Graham Construction Corporation | $351,900 | | $351,900 |
| Visual Display | Product Resource Company | $88,200 | | $88,200 |
| Signage | DMP Sign Co. | $48,350 | | $48,350 |
| Gymnasium Equipment | C & M Associates, LLC | $64,980 | | $64,980 |
| Casework | FCI Group LLC | $557,700 | | $557,700 |
| Network Cabling | Nerds Express, LLC | $168,075 | | $168,075 |
| Site Work | Jacklyn Contracting LLC | $189,000 | | $189,000 |

**Project cost summary**
TOTAL CONTRACTOR COST $6,630,046; CONTINGENCY (10%) $663,004; TOTAL CONSTRUCTION COST $7,293,050.

**Procurement narrative**
The project was advertised on the state website for a total of two and a half weeks and drew a total of 150 bids. The scope is the complete renovation work of Boulan Middle School.

**Exceptions to low bid**
- Metal Panels: still actively under review; Schena Roofing is included in the workshop recommendation, with C.L. Rieckhoff named as the fallback second low bidder if Schena cannot meet the specifications.
- Signage: the two low bidders, Fastsigns and Fastsigns Detroit, both missed the project scope, so the third low bidder, DMP Sign Co., is recommended.
- Roofing: the second low bidder, JD Candler Roofing Company, is recommended because of concerns set out in the attached KJP letter.
- Hard Tile: low bidder Continental Contracting has had many quality and unfinished work issues with the District in the past; with a small increase of only $5,200, second low bidder Premier Tile Design is recommended.
- Glass & Glazing: with approval of Alternate #1, Daniels Glass Co. becomes the new low qualified bid.
- Overhead Doors, Terrazzo, and Acoustic Spray Insulation bids remain under active review and will be the subject of a later recommendation.

**KJP award-concerns letter**
A separate 3/26/2026 letter from Josh Eisenman states that although KJP Roofing submitted the lowest bid, Barton Malow cannot recommend the award, citing quality of workmanship and ability to complete the project per manufacturer and designer requirements, based on previous projects at Waterford Schools and Fraiser Schools and no significant changes to KJP's standard operating procedures.

**Bid tabulation**
The attached tabulation lists every bid by trade. Low bids in the unawarded major trades include Mechanical, Contrast Mechanical, LLC at $3,768,000.00; Electrical, Gemini Electric Company, Inc. at $2,973,685.00; Masonry, Albaugh Masonry Stone and Tile Inc. at $2,251,500.00; Carpentry, Hicks Construction Company at $1,688,008.00; Plumbing, CSM Mechanical LLC at $1,556,000.00; Concrete, Metropolitan Concrete Corp. at $1,265,555.00; and Demolition, KM Construction, LLC at $890,000.00.
